visualCharacteristics.purpose: 'Was this article helpful?' prompt with two feedback buttons (thumbs up / thumbs down) at the end of resource articles

contentPattern.structure: row 1: the question (text or heading); row 2: one cell per answer option, each with its label and an optional icon (e.g. :thumbs-up: / :thumbs-down: icons or images). The question and options may also share one row (question in the first cell). Optional row 3: thank-you message shown after answering (defaults to 'Thanks for your feedback!')

usage: Place at the end of resource/article pages. Options render as buttons; the first is reported as 'positive', the second as 'negative'. Clicking one disables the group, shows the thank-you message, remembers the answer for the session (per path) and dispatches a bubbling 'article-feedback' CustomEvent with { value, label } for analytics wiring. Section background comes from section metadata Style, not a block class.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single-question, few-choice page feedback prompt. It does not submit to a backend; hook the 'article-feedback' event for collection.
